import re

BANNER = re.compile(r"^\s*BTEQ (?P<version>[\d.]+) (?P<started>.+?) PID: (?P<pid>\d+)\s*$")
RULE = re.compile(r"^\+-{3,}")
DASHES = re.compile(r"^-+(?:\s+-+)*\s*$")
STAR = re.compile(r"^\s*\*\*\* (?P<text>\S.*?)\s*$")
QUERY = re.compile(r"^Query completed\. (?P<rows>\d+) rows? found\. (?P<cols>\d+) columns? returned\.$")
ELAPSED = re.compile(r"^Total elapsed time was (?P<elapsed>.+?)\.?$")
RC = re.compile(r"^RC \(return code\) = (?P<rc>\S+)$")
SESSION = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>[A-Z]\w*(?: [A-Z][\w()]*)+) (?:is|was|are) '?(?P<value>\S(?:.*?\S)?)'?\.?$")
STMT_COLS = ["statement", "text", "result", "rows found", "columns returned", "elapsed"]


def spans(dashes):
    return [(m.start(), m.end()) for m in re.finditer(r"-+", dashes)]


def parse(lines):
    session, stmts, results = {}, [], []
    used_s, used_q, skip = [], [], []
    cur = None
    j = 0
    while j < len(lines):
        ln = lines[j]
        if not ln.strip():
            j += 1
            continue
        if RULE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            j += 1
            continue
        m = BANNER.match(ln)
        if m:
            session.update({"BTEQ": m.group("version"), "started": m.group("started"), "PID": m.group("pid")})
            used_s.append(j)
            j += 1
            continue
        m = STAR.match(ln)
        if m:
            text = m.group("text")
            q = QUERY.match(text)
            e = ELAPSED.match(text)
            r = RC.match(text)
            s = SESSION.match(text)
            if r:
                session["RC"] = r.group("rc")
                used_s.append(j)
            elif s:
                session[s.group("key")] = s.group("value")
                used_s.append(j)
            elif cur is not None:
                if q:
                    cur["result"] = "Query completed"
                    cur["rows found"] = q.group("rows")
                    cur["columns returned"] = q.group("cols")
                elif e:
                    cur["elapsed"] = e.group("elapsed")
                else:
                    cur["result"] = (cur["result"] + "; " if cur["result"] else "") + text.rstrip(".")
                used_q.append(j)
            else:
                skip.append(j)
            j += 1
            continue
        # a result set: a header line right above a dashes line, rows until a blank line
        if j + 1 < len(lines) and DASHES.match(lines[j + 1]) and not DASHES.match(ln):
            sp = spans(lines[j + 1])
            cols = [ln[a:b].strip() for a, b in sp]
            lines_r = [j, j + 1]
            rows = []
            k = j + 2
            while k < len(lines) and lines[k].strip():
                row = {"statement": cur["statement"] if cur else ""}
                for (a, b), c in zip(sp, cols):
                    row[c] = lines[k][a:b].strip()
                rows.append(row)
                lines_r.append(k)
                k += 1
            results.append({"name": "rows", "kind": "table", "lines": lines_r, "records": rows})
            j = k
            continue
        # anything else is a statement (BTEQ command or SQL, possibly wrapped over lines)
        if cur is not None and cur["open"]:
            cur["text"] += " " + ln.strip()
        else:
            cur = {k: "" for k in STMT_COLS}
            cur["statement"] = len(stmts) + 1
            cur["text"] = ln.strip()
            stmts.append(cur)
        cur["open"] = not ln.strip().startswith(".") and not ln.rstrip().endswith(";")
        used_q.append(j)
        j += 1
    for s in stmts:
        s.pop("open", None)
    blocks = [{"name": "session", "kind": "kv", "lines": used_s, "records": [session]},
              {"name": "statements", "kind": "table", "lines": used_q, "records": stmts}] + results
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
